changes: First Modwerk release of Zac Kyoti's Direct Jump: hold [PTN] and press [YES] to turn it on, and a pattern you cue takes over on the next step instead of at the end of the playing one.

The new pattern starts where it would be had it played since you pressed PLAY, also with different lengths and per-track scales. The Part, START SILENT and trig conditions change as on a stock pattern change.
Off at every power-on; while off, or while the arranger or a chain runs, pattern changes are the stock ones.
Available for card builds and, for beta testers, over USB. Tested on an MKII over USB: install, the toggle, jumps between a 64- and a 16-step pattern, a power cycle and removal.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware with a jump into another Part, per-track scales, external MIDI gear, the arranger or chains, or on an MKI.
